style: Say casually and naturally, like a friendly teenager explaining something
lines: Pick a case card and press Open case. We have eight kits, so plan your stops.
Tap a spot, choose Dry day or Day after storm, then press Take sample.
Nice, that pair brackets a suspect. A jump between them is evidence.
Last kit. Make it count.
Out of kits. Go to Claim and make your case, or press Restart case.
Check sources with at least 20 percent at an over-limit target, dry or storm. Then press Add evidence.
That's the case. Every source has evidence behind it.
Press Add on the fixes you want, keep the bar under three million, then press Test plan.
This plan misses a goal. Compare the gauges, change a fix, or press Save plan and explain your priorities.
Tap the samples that support this source. Then press Use evidence.
Tap two logbook entries. Then press Compare selected.
Read the feedback. Change a suspect or its evidence, then press Submit claim again.
Your plan is saved on this device. Press Compare plans to add your reason.
Read the before and after gauges. Change a fix, or press Save plan.
Type why you chose this plan in its Why box. Close to return to Fix-it.
Read the effects and who pays for each fix. Press Close, then Add or Remove a fix and Test plan.
Over budget. Press Remove on a fix to bring the cost within three million.
No samples yet. Press Close, then Sample, choose a spot and weather, and press Take sample.
Press Close, then Test plan and Save plan. You can keep three plans to compare.
Press Close, then Remove a fix. Bring the cost within three million before testing and saving.
